SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION IS A CALIFORNIA NOT-FOR-PROFIT CORPORATION EXEMPT FROM FEDERAL AND STATE INCOME TAXES UNDER INTERNAL REVENUE CODE SECTION 501(C)(3) AND CALIFORNIA REVENUE AND TAX CODE 23701(D). HOWEVER, CERTAIN OPERATIONS OF THE ORGANIZATION MAY QUALIFY AS UNRELATED BUSINESS TAXABLE INCOME AND, TO THE EXTENT THAT THESE OPERATIONS GENERATE INCOME, THEY WILL BE SUBJECT TO FEDERAL AND STATE TAXES. DURING THE YEARS ENDED SEPTEMBER 30, 2024 AND 2023, RESPECTIVELY, THERE WAS NO UNRELATED BUSINESS INCOME FOR THE ORGANIZATION. THE ORGANIZATION'S FEDERAL AND STATE INFORMATION RETURNS PRIOR TO FISCAL YEAR 2021 ARE CLOSED AND MANAGEMENT CONTINUALLY EVALUATES EXPIRING STATUTES OF LIMITATIONS, AUDITS, PROPOSED SETTLEMENTS, CHANGES IN TAX LAW AND NEW AUTHORITATIVE RULINGS. MANAGEMENT HAS ANALYZED THE TAX POSITIONS TAKEN BY THE ORGANIZATION AND HAS CONCLUDED THAT, AS OF SEPTEMBER 30, 2024, THERE ARE NO UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS TAKEN OR EXPECTED TO BE TAKEN THAT WOULD REQUIRE RECOGNITION OF A LIABILITY (OR ASSET) OR DISCLOSURE IN THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS. THE ORGANIZATION RECOGNIZES INTEREST AND PENALTIES ASSOCIATED WITH TAX MATTERS AS PART OF MANAGEMENT AND GENERAL EXPENSES AND INCLUDES ACCRUED INTEREST AND PENALTIES IN ACCRUED EXPENSES IN THE STATEMENTS OF FINANCIAL POSITION. THERE WERE NO INTEREST OR PENALTIES FOR THE YEARS ENDED SEPTEMBER 30, 2024 AND 2023.

GSSD PROVIDES FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE TO VOLUNTEERS AND GIRLS WHO ARE UNABLE TO AFFORD GIRL SCOUT PROGRAMS OR GSUSA MEMBERSHIP FEES. THE ASSISTANCE OFFSETS THE COSTS AND IS NOT GRANTED DIRECTLY TO THE FAMILIES. FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE IS CAREFULLY CONSIDERED BASED ON NEED AND GRANTED REGARDLESS OF RACE, COLOR, ETHNICITY, CREED, NATIONAL ORIGIN, SOCIOECONOMIC STATUS, OR DISABILITY. THE AMOUNT OF FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE OFFERED IS BASED ON AVAILABLE FUNDS IN THE ANNUAL FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE BUDGET.
THE NUMBER OF INDIVIDUALS WHO RECEIVED ASSISTANCE IS REPORTED.

ERIC WILLIAMS LIVES ON PROPERTY AT BALBOA AND AS PART OF HIS POSITION, HE IS THE CARE-TAKER OF THE BALBOA CAMPUS. HE IS PROVIDED HOUSING FOR THE BENEFIT OF THE ORGANIZATION. THE BENEFIT WAS NOT TREATED AS TAXABLE COMPENSATION BECAUSE IT MET THE FOLLOWING REQUIREMENTS: - THE HOUSING IS PROVIDED ON THE PROPERTY OWNED BY THE BUSINESS OR EMPLOYER. - THE HOUSING IS PROVIDED FOR THE CONVENIENCE OF THE EMPLOYER. - THE EMPLOYER HAD A "SUBSTANTIAL BUSINESS REASON" FOR THIS. - THE EMPLOYEE ACCEPTED HOUSING AS A CONDITION OF EMPLOYMENT.

THE COUNCIL USES INDEPENDENT REVIEW OF THE SALARIES TO ESTABLISH CEO COMPENSATION. THE BOARD APPOINTS AN EXECUTIVE COMPENSATION COMMITTEE, WHICH WORKS WITH THE DIRECTOR OF HUMAN RESOURCES TO GATHER PERTINENT SALARY INFORMATION, RELATIVE TO SIMILAR POSITIONS ACROSS THE US, AS WELL AS IN SAN DIEGO. THE COMMITTEE MEETS ANNUALLY, CONSIDERS THE IMPACT OF THE COUNCIL'S GEOGRAPHICAL LOCATION ON SALARIES IN OUR REGION, AND CONSIDERS MERIT WHEN ESTABLISHING THE CEO'S COMPENSATION FOR THE NEXT YEAR. THE COMPENSATION FOR OTHER KEY EMPLOYEES IS SET BY THE CEO AND THE HUMAN RESOURCES DEPARTMENT, TAKING INTO ACCOUNT VARIOUS FACTORS, INCLUDING EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE AND MARKET SALARY INFORMATION.

GIRL SCOUTS, SAN DIEGO-IMPERIAL COUNCIL, INC. ("GSSD") USES AN ORGANIZATION TO ACCEPT VEHICLES OR OTHER PROPERTY DONATIONS MADE TO GSSD. SUBSEQUENTLY, THE DONATIONS ARE LIQUIDATED, AND A PORTION THEREOF IS SENT TO GSSD.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART III, LINE 1, ORGANIZATION'S MISSION:
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: AS PART OF THE PREMIER GIRL LEADERSHIP DEVELOPMENT ORGANIZATION IN THE COUNTRY AND THE UNDISPUTED EXPERT ON GIRLS, GIRL SCOUTS HAS, FOR OVER 100 YEARS, PREPARED GIRLS TO SUCCESSFULLY FACE LIFE CHALLENGES WITH COURAGE, CONFIDENCE, AND CHARACTER. GIRL SCOUTS DELIVERS EXCEPTIONAL EXPERIENCES FOR GIRLS IN THESE FOUR PROGRAM AREAS: STEM (SCIENCE, TECHNOLOGY, ENGINEERING, AND MATH), THE OUTDOORS, ENTREPRENEURSHIP, AND LIFE SKILLS. WITH THE HELP OF APPROXIMATELY 9,000 ADULTS AND IN COLLABORATION WITH SCHOOLS, NONPROFIT ORGANIZATIONS, AND COMMUNITY PARTNERS, GIRL SCOUTS SAN DIEGO (GSSD) SERVES MORE THAN 15,000 GIRLS IN GRADES K-12 THROUGHOUT SAN DIEGO AND IMPERIAL COUNTIES. GSSD RELIES ON VOLUNTEERS TO ADVANCE THE MISSION, INCLUDING ALUMNAE, WOMEN WHO GREW UP AS GIRL SCOUTS AND ARE ROLE MODELS TO GIRLS WHO WILL BE THE NEXT GENERATION OF LEADERS. SERVING GIRLS FOR MORE THAN 111 YEARS, GIRL SCOUTS CONTINUES TO STAY RELEVANT AND VITAL TO THE NEEDS OF GIRLS AND YOUNG WOMEN THROUGH ITS PROVEN EFFECTIVE PROGRAMS DELIVERED IN AN ALL-GIRL, GIRL-LED ENVIRONMENT. WHETHER IT'S AN OUTDOOR ADVENTURE, EXPLORING SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY, OR MAKING THE WORLD A BETTER PLACE WHILE HAVING FUN WITH FRIENDS, GIRLS ARE PREPARING FOR A LIFETIME OF LEADERSHIP, ADVENTURE, AND SUCCESS. GIRL SCOUTS' STAFF AND VOLUNTEERS CREATE SAFE OPPORTUNITIES FOR GIRLS TO CONNECT WITH THEIR SISTER GIRL SCOUTS AND PARTICIPATE IN FUN, ENGAGING TROOP ACTIVITIES. GSSD'S STRATEGIC VISION IS TO BE VIEWED AND VALUED AS THE GO-TO PARTNER FOR DEVELOPING AND ELEVATING GIRL AND WOMEN LEADERS IN SAN DIEGO AND IMPERIAL COUNTIES. BEYOND TRADITIONAL LEADERSHIP DEVELOPMENT, OUR RELEVANT PROGRAMS AND EXPERIENCES FOSTER A SENSE OF WELL-BEING IN GIRLS, SO THEY ARE WELL-ROUNDED INDIVIDUALS POISED FOR SUCCESS IN LIFE. GIRL SCOUTS HAS ENGAGED AND INSPIRED GENERATIONS OF LEADERS. GIRL SCOUTS' TRIED AND PROVEN PROGRAMS HAVE DEVELOPED THE LEADERSHIP SKILLS OF MORE THAN 59 MILLION WOMEN WHO HAVE GONE ON TO SHAPE THE COURSE OF OUR NATION'S HISTORY. IN ADDITION TO SHATTERING BARRIERS AND TRANSFORMING CULTURE, WOMEN SUCH AS MADELEINE ALBRIGHT, LAURA BUSH, HILLARY RODHAM CLINTON, MELINDA GATES, BARBARA WALTERS, KATIE COURIC, VENUS WILLIAMS, JACKIE JOYNER-KERSEE, AND SHERYL CROW HAVE PROUDLY WORN THE GIRL SCOUT TREFOIL. GSSD CONTINUES IN THIS GRAND TRADITION, PROVIDING GIRLS AND YOUNG WOMEN WITH THE VALUES, LIFE SKILLS, AND TOOLS THEY NEED TO DISCOVER WHO THEY CAN BE, WHAT THEY CAN DO, AND HOW THEY CAN CHANGE THE WORLD.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART III, LINE 4A, PROGRAM SERVICE ACCOMPLISHMENTS:
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: MISSION DELIVERY PROGRAMS: GIRL SCOUTS HAS FOUR PROGRAM AREAS: STEM, THE OUTDOORS, ENTREPRENEURSHIP, AND LIFE SKILLS. GIRL SCOUT PROGRAMS PROVIDE EXPERIENCE IN LEADERSHIP DEVELOPMENT, SKILL BUILDING, AND COMMUNITY SERVICE. THEY ARE GIRL-LED, COOPERATIVE, INTERACTIVE, AND GUIDE GIRLS TO THESE FIVE OUTCOMES: GIRL SCOUTS DEVELOP A STRONG SENSE OF SELF; DISPLAY POSITIVE VALUES; SEEK CHALLENGES AND LEARN FROM SETBACKS; FORM AND MAINTAIN HEALTHY RELATIONSHIPS; AND IDENTIFY AND SOLVE PROBLEMS IN THE COMMUNITY. LEADERSHIP - A CORNERSTONE OF GIRL SCOUTS IS LEADERSHIP DEVELOPMENT. DISCOVER + CONNECT + TAKE ACTION = LEADERSHIP. IN GIRL SCOUTS, GIRLS DISCOVER AND LEARN SKILLS WHILE EXPLORING THEIR INTERESTS AND CONNECTING WITH OTHERS TO TAKE ACTION AND MAKE THE WORLD A BETTER PLACE. GSSD ANNUALLY HONORS AND CELEBRATES WOMEN, WHO ARE INFLUENTIAL LEADERS, AND EMERGING LEADER GIRL SCOUTS AT OUR COOL WOMEN CELEBRATION. EMERGING LEADER GIRL SCOUTS ARE TEENS WHO EMBODY THE MISSION AND PROMISE OF GIRL SCOUTS TO MAKE THE WORLD A BETTER PLACE AND EXEMPLIFY THE HIGHEST CALIBER OF LEADERSHIP, COURAGE, CONFIDENCE, AND CHARACTER. THE EVENT IS MORE THAN A LUNCHEON. THE WOMEN (MANY WHO GREW UP AS GIRL SCOUTS) AND GIRLS PARTICIPATE IN NETWORKING AND MENTORING SESSIONS, AND THE GIRLS HAVE AN OPPORTUNITY TO MEET WITH EXECUTIVES FROM MANY ORGANIZATIONS. HIGHEST AWARDS - GIRL SCOUTS LEARN LIFE SKILLS AND HOW TO IDENTIFY AND SOLVE COMMUNITY PROBLEMS AS THEY EARN THE HIGHEST AWARDS IN GIRL SCOUTS: THE GIRL SCOUT GOLD AWARD FOR SENIORS AND AMBASSADORS (GIRLS IN 9-12 GRADES), THE GIRL SCOUT SILVER AWARD FOR CADETTES (GIRLS IN 6-8 GRADES), AND THE GIRL SCOUT BRONZE AWARD FOR JUNIORS (GIRLS IN 4-5 GRADES). GOLD AWARD GIRL SCOUTS ARE THE DREAMERS AND THE DOERS WHO TAKE "MAKE THE WORLD A BETTER PLACE" TO THE NEXT LEVEL. THE GIRL SCOUT GOLD AWARD IS THE MARK OF THE TRULY REMARKABLE-PROOF THAT NOT ONLY CAN SHE MAKE A DIFFERENCE, BUT THAT SHE ALREADY HAS. THE GIRL SCOUT GOLD AWARD IS A TWO-YEAR UNDERTAKING AND REQUIRES A HIGH SCHOOL GIRL SCOUT TO COMPLETE LEADERSHIP TRAINING; DEVELOP A LARGE-SCALE "TAKE ACTION" PROJECT THAT HAS LASTING IMPACT; AND DEDICATE A MINIMUM OF 80 HOURS TO PLANNING AND IMPLEMENTATION WHILE MANAGING THE PROJECT AND THE VOLUNTEERS. THE HIGHEST ACHIEVEMENT IN GIRL SCOUTING, THE GOLD AWARD IS A TOP-TIER CREDENTIAL FOR GIRLS AS THEY ENTER THEIR POST-HIGH SCHOOL LIVES, ENABLING THEM TO DISTINGUISH THEMSELVES IN THE COLLEGE ADMISSIONS PROCESS, EARN COLLEGE SCHOLARSHIPS, AND ENLIST IN THE MILITARY AT A HIGHER PAY GRADE. OUR 2024 GOLD AWARD CEREMONY CELEBRATED 72 GOLD AWARD GIRL SCOUTS. GIRL SCOUTS WHO EARN THE GOLD AWARD NOT ONLY CHANGE THE WORLD FOR THE BETTER, THEY CHANGE IT FOR GOOD. THE GIRL SCOUT GOLD AWARD, KNOWN AS THE MARK OF THE TRULY REMARKABLE, IS THE HIGHEST AWARD A GIRL SCOUT CAN EARN. ONCE ACHIEVED, IT SHOWS COLLEGES, EMPLOYERS, AND THE COMMUNITY THAT GIRL SCOUTS ARE OUT THERE CHANGING THE WORLD. GOLD AWARD GIRL SCOUTS ARE IMPRESSIVE TO COLLEGES, UNIVERSITIES, AND EMPLOYERS-INCLUDING THE MILITARY, WHICH ENABLES GOLD AWARD GIRL SCOUTS TO ENLIST AT A HIGHER PAY GRADE. IT REQUIRES GIRLS TO DEMONSTRATE THEIR LEADERSHIP ABILITIES BY CREATING SUSTAINABLE PROJECTS THAT ADDRESS AND IMPACT LOCAL AND GLOBAL ISSUES. EARNING THE AWARD IS OFTEN A MULTI-YEAR PROCESS, WHICH INCLUDES PROVIDING MORE THAN 80 HOURS OF COMMUNITY SERVICE, EDUCATION, AND ADVOCACY.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART III, LINE 4B, PROGRAM SERVICE ACCOMPLISHMENTS:
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: GIRL AND VOLUNTEER DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM: ENHANCING AND INCREASING GIRL AND VOLUNTEER ENGAGEMENT ARE TOP PRIORITIES TO DELIVERING AND ACHIEVING THE GIRL SCOUT MISSION. GIRL DEVELOPMENT: GIRL SCOUTS FOCUSES ON DELIVERING LEADERSHIP DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMS TO GIRLS IN GRADES K-12 THROUGHOUT SAN DIEGO AND IMPERIAL COUNTIES REGARDLESS OF THEIR SOCIAL, RELIGIOUS, ETHNIC, OR FINANCIAL BACKGROUNDS. THESE TIME-TESTED METHODS AND RESEARCH-BACKED PROGRAMS MAKE UP THE GIRL SCOUT LEADERSHIP EXPERIENCE AND PREPARE EVERY GIRL TO TAKE THE LEAD IN HER LIFE AND IN THE WORLD. GIRLS DEVELOP VALUABLE LIFE SKILLS AND LEARN TO BE CONFIDENT, DETERMINED, COLLABORATIVE, AND RESILIENT. GSSD DEVELOPS GIRL PROGRAMS (TAILORED TO THE AGE LEVEL OF THE GIRLS) TO HELP GIRLS IDENTIFY AND RESOLVE NEEDS IN THEIR COMMUNITY, AS WELL AS VOLUNTEER TRAINING TO EMPOWER TRUSTED ADULTS TO DELIVER THE PROGRAMS IN A SAFE, GIRL-LED ENVIRONMENT. WHILE CONTINUING TO ENHANCE PROGRAMS AND SERVICES THROUGHOUT OUR REGION, GSSD IS FOCUSED ON REACHING UNDERSERVED COMMUNITIES. APPROXIMATELY FORTY PERCENT OF OUR LOCAL MEMBERS LIVE IN LOW-INCOME HOUSEHOLDS. GSSD'S PROGRAMS ARE AVAILABLE TO ALL GIRLS, REGARDLESS OF THEIR FAMILIES' ABILITY TO PAY. THE OPPORTUNITIES THAT ARE OPEN TO THESE YOUNG WOMEN CAN TRULY BE LIFECHANGING. VOLUNTEER DEVELOPMENT: WITH ROUGHLY 9,000 REGISTERED ADULT MEMBERS, VOLUNTEER DEVELOPMENT AND TRAINING ARE CRITICAL TO THE GIRL SCOUT MISSION BECAUSE VOLUNTEERS DELIVER THE VAST MAJORITY OF PROGRAMMING FOR MORE THAN 15,000 LOCAL GIRL SCOUTS. GSSD VOLUNTEERS ARE A DIVERSE GROUP OF WOMEN AND MEN, COMING FROM A WIDE VARIETY OF BACKGROUNDS INCLUDING PROFESSIONALS, COLLEGE STUDENTS, RETIREES, AND PARENTS. MANY GREW UP AS GIRL SCOUTS BUT NOT ALL. IT IS NOT A REQUIREMENT TO HAVE BEEN A GIRL SCOUT GROWING UP. EVERY GSSD VOLUNTEER UNDERGOES A BACKGROUND CHECK, LIVE SCAN FINGERPRINTING, AND PARTICIPATES IN VARIOUS TRAININGS IN ORDER TO BE EQUIPPED TO TEACH AND TRAIN GIRLS OR OTHER VOLUNTEERS AT THE TROOP, SERVICE AREA, REGION, OR COUNCIL LEVEL. THESE TRAININGS, OFFERED MONTHLY, QUARTERLY, OR ANNUALLY BASED ON THE SUBJECT, ARE DELIVERED BY STAFF OR QUALIFIED VOLUNTEERS EITHER IN PERSON OR VIRTUALLY. SOME OF THE TOPICS INCLUDE: INTRODUCTION TO GIRL SCOUTS, BEING A TROOP LEADER (OFFERED FOR ALL AGE LEVELS, K-12), OUTDOOR TROOP CAMPING, ALL ASPECTS OF THE COOKIE PROGRAM, SERVICE UNIT MANAGER, ADULT EDUCATOR, SPECIAL EVENT MANAGERS, FIRST AID, AND CPR FOR ADULT AND CHILD. THE MEMBERSHIP TEAM RECRUITS VOLUNTEERS, PROVIDES ASSISTANCE, INTERVIEWS AND ASSESSES FIT WITH POSITION, MONITORS CRIMINAL BACKGROUND CHECKS, AND EVALUATES AND RECOGNIZES ACHIEVEMENTS OF VOLUNTEERS. VOLUNTEERS ARE RECOGNIZED AT THE TROOP AND SERVICE UNIT LEVELS, ALONG WITH EACH YEAR AT THE COUNCIL-WIDE VOLUNTEER RECOGNITION CEREMONY. IN ADDITION, GSSD PROUDLY RECOGNIZES VOLUNTEERS WITH NATIONAL AWARDS FOR THEIR OUTSTANDING SERVICE. VOLUNTEERS GAIN SKILLS THAT DIRECTLY BENEFIT GIRLS THROUGHOUT THE COMMUNITY, AND THE TRAININGS AND TOOLS ALSO BENEFIT VOLUNTEERS BY EXPANDING THEIR KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLSET IN SUCH THINGS AS PLANNING, MANAGING, ORGANIZING, AND FACILITATING. THE VOLUNTEER IS HEAVILY INVOLVED IN THE DEVELOPMENT OF GIRLS AND PLAYS A MAJOR ROLE IN ORGANIZING COMMUNITY SERVICE PROJECTS. THROUGH THESE COMMUNITY SERVICE PROJECTS, VOLUNTEERS ARE TEACHING GIRLS THE IMPORTANCE OF GIVING BACK WHILE ALSO PERSONALLY LIFTING UP THEIR COMMUNITIES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART III, LINE 4C, PROGRAM SERVICE ACCOMPLISHMENTS:
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: BUSINESS AND FINANCIAL LITERACY PROGRAM: TEACHING GIRLS BUSINESS AND FINANCIAL LITERACY SKILLS AND GIVING THEM VALUABLE ENTREPRENEURIAL EXPERIENCES IS WHY MANY OF OUR GIRL SCOUTS HAVE BECOME SUCCESSFUL BUSINESS LEADERS. THE GIRL SCOUT COOKIE PROGRAM IS THE LARGEST FINANCIAL LITERACY AND ENTREPRENEUR PROGRAM IN THE WORLD FOR GIRLS. IT HAS BEEN A CORNERSTONE PROGRAM IN GIRL SCOUTS FOR MORE THAN 100 YEARS. THIS PROGRAM AS WELL AS THE FALL PRODUCT PROGRAM, HELP GIRLS BUILD CONFIDENCE WHILE LEARNING BUSINESS AND MARKETING SKILLS, GOAL SETTING, DECISION MAKING, MONEY MANAGEMENT, PEOPLE SKILLS, AND BUSINESS ETHICS. BY PARTICIPATING IN MONEY-EARNING, FINANCIAL LITERACY PROJECTS, GIRLS IN SAN DIEGO AND IMPERIAL COUNTIES BUILD REAL-WORLD SKILLS THAT ALSO BENEFIT THEIR TROOP, COUNCIL, AND COMMUNITY. THESE FINANCIAL EDUCATION PROGRAMS HELP GIRLS GAIN THE CONFIDENCE AND SKILLS TO BECOME SUCCESSFUL BUSINESS LEADERS AND ENTREPRENEURS AND MANAGE THEIR FINANCIAL FUTURES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: STAFF PROVIDES THE REQUIRED INPUTS TO OUR INDEPENDENT ACCOUNTANTS WHO PREPARE THE DRAFT TAX RETURN. THE DRAFT RETURN IS REVIEWED BY STAFF AND ANY NECESSARY REVISIONS ARE MADE TO THE TAX RETURN. A COPY OF THE TAX RETURN IS MADE AVAILABLE TO THE FINANCE COMMITTEE AND BOARD MEMBERS FOR THEIR REVIEW. ANY QUESTIONS ARE DIRECTED TO STAFF, AND THE BOARD ANNUALLY ACKNOWLEDGES FILING OF THE FORM 990 RETURN.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY IS PROVIDED TO THE BOARD MEMBERS ANNUALLY TO REVIEW AND SIGN. SIGNED CONFLICT OF INTEREST STATEMENTS ARE REVIEWED FOR ANY POTENTIAL CONFLICTS NOTED. IF ANY ISSUE IS NOTED, THE RESPECTIVE BOARD AND/OR COMMITTEE INVESTIGATES THE FACTS AND DETERMINES WHETHER AN ACTUAL CONFLICT EXISTS. AFTER REVIEW OF ALL MATERIAL FACTS, THE BOARD/COMMITTEE WILL DETERMINE A SOLUTION, THROUGH VARIOUS MEANS, TO ELIMINATE THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST. ACTIONS MAY INCLUDE, BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO, CONSIDERING ALTERNATIVE TRANSACTIONS WHICH WOULD NOT CREATE A CONFLICT OF INTEREST, RECUSING THE CONFLICTED MEMBER FROM DISCUSSION AND VOTING ON THE CONFLICTING TOPIC, OR REMOVING THE CONFLICTING PARTY FROM THE BOARD/COMMITTEE.
